name: Arranged Marriage Romance
description: Contemporary romance navigating the uniquely Indian arranged marriage market.

chapters.title: The Biodata
chapters.description: The protagonist faces the pressure of matchmaking and absurd matrimonial profiles.

chapters.title: The Awkward First Meeting
chapters.description: Meeting the prospective match over chai and samosas with families present.

chapters.title: The Reluctant Agreement
chapters.description: Agreeing to the match due to family pressure or a surprising spark.

chapters.title: The Courtship Phase
chapters.description: Chaperoned dates, endless WhatsApp chats, and finding common ground.

chapters.title: The Past Resurfaces
chapters.description: An ex-lover returns, or a secret from the past is revealed.

chapters.title: The Pre-Wedding Jitters
chapters.description: Sangeet and Mehendi chaos; the realization of what marriage actually means.

chapters.title: The Big Fat Indian Wedding
chapters.description: The exhausting, colorful multi-day ceremony and a moment of connection.

chapters.title: The Honeymoon Phase
chapters.description: Traveling together; physical intimacy and awkward adjustments.

chapters.title: The In-Law Dynamics
chapters.description: Moving in together; navigating expectations of the extended family.

chapters.title: The First Real Fight
chapters.description: A clash of values or modern vs. traditional expectations.

chapters.title: The Compromise
chapters.description: Learning to communicate; choosing the partner over the family.

chapters.title: True Love Discovered
chapters.description: Realizing that love grew after marriage; a solid, chosen partnership.
